title: How Loud Rumbles Hit Newsstands: A Data Analysis of Coverage and Spatial Bias in German News about Landslides Around the World

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the geographic distribution of geolocated news events about landslides in German media to independent external databases of actual and predicted landslide occurrences (EM-DAT and WB-GLHM) to calculate salience divergence and identify overreported and underreported countries or regions.

Evaluating the proportion of media coverage grouped by the affected countries' development status (Global North vs. Global South) and economic income levels compared to expected real-world hazard baselines.
